before.exam_tip_html: For the 8-mark “create” question you will be asked to hand-sketch a design tool for a given scenario — often a mind map, flow chart or wireframe. The biggest mark losses come from missing labels and diagrams that ignore the scenario. Use all four standard flow chart symbols if you draw a flow chart, label every branch of a mind map, and annotate every section of a wireframe. Examiners reward completeness, correct use of symbols and a clear link back to the named scenario — not artistic quality.
